notes: - Pictures and voice notes now go out every way the page allows. On the real Messages page the file could silently never reach the compose box, so the picture simply never arrived. Attaching was rebuilt: the sender now tries, in order, the attach button's file picker (including its menu), the Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+A shortcut's picker, the hidden file box, and pasting — then dropping — the file itself into the compose box, and it checks the file's preview is showing before pressing Send. If a way fails, the next is tried. And when nothing works, the failure now names each step that was tried, so the Activity log says exactly what the page did instead of a silent nothing. Proven in a real browser against pages that allow only one route each (picker only, paste only, file box only).
